title: AutoHideContainer prevents update of outdated values
body:
**Bug report** / instantsearch.js

## Summary

When refining leads to no results, and auto hide container is on on a widget, the numeric refinement list appearance may not be updated consistently with the search state after a clear all. It seems link to the optimizations of the autohidecontainer HoC.

## Steps to reproduce the bug

* go to https://jsfiddle.net/0wm3donb/8/
* choose over 10
* \--> no results
* clear everything
* over 10 is still selected but there is no refine (the currentRefinedValues shows nothing) and if we inspect the DOM the correct values is checked

## Impacted version and test browser

This issue has been tested in Chrome with the latest develop branch and the latest version from the jsFiddle.
